targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (${select_export_data_list}) or
      r["_field"] == "qrcode" or
      r["_field"] == "serialboard_id" or
      r["_field"] == "protectboard_id"
  )

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["pallet_position"] == "${pallet_position}")

  |> pivot(
      rowKey: [
          "_time",
          "position_id",
          "storehouse_id",
          "pallet_position"
      ],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      exists r.qrcode
  )

  
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with

      StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,

      SerialBoardID:
          if exists r.serialboard_id then
              string(v: r.serialboard_id)
          else
              "",

      ProtectBoardID:
          if exists r.protectboard_id then
              string(v: r.protectboard_id)
          else
              "",

      QRCode:
          string(v: r.qrcode)
  }))

  |> keep(columns: [
      "_time",

      "StoreHouseID",
      "SerialBoardID",
      "ProtectBoardID",
      "QRCode",

      "position_id",
      "pallet_position",

      "voltage",
      "temperature",
      "current"
  ])

  |> group()

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_field"] == "voltage" or
      r["_field"] == "qrcode"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["pallet_position"] == "${pallet_position}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${position_id_list})
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time", "position_id"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.voltage and exists r.qrcode)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: float(v: r.voltage),
      _field: string(v: r.qrcode)
  }))
  |> drop(columns: ["voltage", "qrcode"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(
      every: v.windowPeriod,
      fn: last,
      createEmpty: false
  )

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.QRCode AS [__text],
    m.QRCode AS [__value]
FROM [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m
WHERE m.StoreHouseID = CAST(${rack_id:sqlstring} AS INT)
  AND m.SerialBoardID IN (${serialboard_id:sqlstring})
  AND m.PalletPosition IN (${pallet_position:sqlstring})
  AND m.StartTime >= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeFrom())
  AND m.StartTime <= DATEADD(HOUR, 0, $__timeTo())
ORDER BY [__value];

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT '${qrcode_list:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS QRCode
    FROM raw AS r
    CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
),
mapped AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           m.PositionID
    FROM split_expr AS s
    INNER JOIN [BALPS].[dbo].[MeasSessionIndex] AS m
        ON m.QRCode = s.QRCode
    WHERE m.PositionID IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN '${qrcode_list:text}' = 'All' THEN
            'true'
        ELSE
            STRING_AGG(
                'r["position_id"] == "' +
                CAST(PositionID AS NVARCHAR(100)) +
                '"',
                ' or '
            )
    END AS result
FROM mapped;

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${select_export_data:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["_field"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;
